feature.name: Bug / Feature Request Form
feature.summary: Adds a Feedback navigation item (authenticated users only) that opens a FeedbackPage.vue with three sub-forms: Bug Report, Feature Request, and Agent Request. On submission, a POST /api/feedback endpoint creates a GitHub Issue in organization/self-service-infra with appropriate labels and returns the issue URL to the user.

user_stories.i_want: to navigate to a Feedback page via the top navigation bar
user_stories.so_that: I can easily access the feedback form without leaving the application
acceptance_criteria: A 'Feedback' nav item appears in SharedHeader only when isAuthenticated is true
Clicking 'Feedback' navigates to currentPage === 'feedback'
Unauthenticated users do not see the Feedback nav item

user_stories.i_want: to submit a Bug Report with structured fields
user_stories.so_that: the DevOps team receives a well-formatted issue describing the defect
acceptance_criteria: Bug Report form collects: title (required, ≤120 chars), observedBehaviour (required), expectedBehaviour (required), stepsToReproduce (optional), severity (required: Critical|High|Medium|Low)
Submitting creates a GitHub Issue labelled 'bug' in organization/self-service-infra
Issue body uses the Bug markdown template with all required sections
Success state displays the created issue URL as a clickable link
Validation errors are shown inline without page reload

user_stories.i_want: to submit a Feature Request with structured fields
user_stories.so_that: the team can evaluate and prioritise the enhancement
acceptance_criteria: Feature Request form collects: title (required, ≤120 chars), painPoint (required), desiredOutcome (required), businessJustification (optional), priority (required: High|Medium|Low)
Submitting creates a GitHub Issue labelled 'enhancement' in organization/self-service-infra
Issue body uses the Feature markdown template with all required sections
Success state displays the created issue URL

user_stories.i_want: to submit an Agent Request with structured fields
user_stories.so_that: the team can build or improve AI agent capabilities
acceptance_criteria: Agent Request form collects: title (required, ≤120 chars), agentType (required — populated from GET /api/agents dropdown), agentBehaviour (required), businessJustification (required)
Submitting creates a GitHub Issue labelled 'agent-request' in organization/self-service-infra
Issue body uses the Agent markdown template with all required sections
Success state displays the created issue URL

user_stories.i_want: to see real-time validation feedback while filling in the form
user_stories.so_that: I can correct mistakes before submitting
acceptance_criteria: Required fields display an error message on blur or submit attempt if empty
Title field shows a character count and error if > 120 characters
Submit button is disabled while submission is in progress
All form controls have accessible labels meeting WCAG 2.1 AA
POST /api/feedback returns HTTP 201 with { success: true, issueUrl, issueNumber, correlationId } on success
POST /api/feedback returns HTTP 400 with validation errors for missing/invalid fields
POST /api/feedback returns HTTP 401 when called without a valid session
POST /api/feedback returns HTTP 429 when GitHub rate-limits the request, including a retryAfter hint
POST /api/feedback returns HTTP 503 when the GitHub API call times out (threshold: 10 s)
POST /api/feedback returns HTTP 500 for other GitHub API failures
GitHub Issue body contains no raw HTML — all user input is stripped/escaped before insertion
correlationId is present in every log line emitted during the request lifecycle
npm run type-check exits 0 (TypeScript compilation clean)
Zero critical axe-core accessibility violations on the FeedbackPage

backend.description: Add createIssue() method to GitHubService class using the main octokit client (infrastructure app)

new_methods.name: createIssue
new_methods.description: Creates a GitHub Issue in the given repo using the main octokit (infrastructure app). Logs duration via logMetric. Handles 429 by re-throwing with retryAfter, 5xx with wrapped error.
new_methods.pattern: Follow the same try/catch/logMetric pattern used in createPullRequest() — call ensureInitialized(), split repo into [owner, repoName], call octokit.rest.issues.create({ owner, repo: repoName, title, body, labels }), return { issueUrl: response.data.html_url, issueNumber: response.data.number }

error_handling.status_422: Re-throw with validation message from GitHub
error_handling.timeout: Wrap call in Promise.race with 10 s timeout; reject with error.code = 'GITHUB_TIMEOUT'

flows.name: Happy path — Bug Report submission
steps: 2. FeedbackPage mounts — loads agent list via GET /api/agents (used by Agent Request tab)
3. User selects 'Bug Report' tab, fills title, observedBehaviour, expectedBehaviour, severity
4. User clicks Submit — FeedbackPage sends POST /api/feedback with type='bug' and form fields
5. api.js route validates input via express-validator
7. githubService.createIssue sanitises fields, renders markdown template, calls octokit.rest.issues.create
9. Route responds HTTP 201 { success: true, issueUrl, issueNumber, correlationId }
10. FeedbackPage transitions to success state — shows issue URL link

githubService attaches retryAfter; route returns 429; FeedbackPage shows retry message
githubService rejects with GITHUB_TIMEOUT; route returns 503; FeedbackPage shows service-unavailable message
githubService re-throws; route returns 500; FeedbackPage shows generic error
